claims: The Phoenix Suns lost Game 1 of their first-round playoff series against the Oklahoma City Thunder with a final score of 119-84 on Sunday, April 19, 2026.
The final score of Game 1 was Oklahoma City Thunder 119, Phoenix Suns 84.
The Phoenix Suns are facing a 1-0 series deficit.
Game 2 between the Phoenix Suns and the Oklahoma City Thunder is scheduled for Wednesday, April 22, 2026.
Game 2 matchup is Phoenix Suns at Oklahoma City Thunder.
Game 2 location is Paycom Center, Oklahoma City, OK.
Devin Booker was the top scorer for the Phoenix Suns with 23 points in Game 1.
The Phoenix Suns committed 34 turnovers in Game 1.
The Phoenix Suns trailed by as many as 39 points in Game 1.
Jordan Goodwin (left calf) did not return in Game 1.
Mark Williams was out in Game 1.
